module_audit.finding: Execution was deterministic, but exit legs lacked their explicit market date.
module_audit.resolution: Every partial and final exit leg now stores its source candle date.

module_audit.finding: Caller-provided equity points were trusted in their incoming order.
module_audit.resolution: Duplicate sessions collapse to their final value and sessions are sorted before drawdown.

module_audit.finding: Trade-level R was accumulated in list order instead of dated exit-leg order.
module_audit.resolution: All calibration drawdowns now aggregate realised exit-leg R by session.

module_audit.finding: Variant drawdowns depended on ticker iteration.
module_audit.resolution: All variant, band, and regime drawdowns now use dated exit legs.

module_audit.finding: The 81-cell matrix accumulated trades in ticker order.
module_audit.resolution: Every overall, sector, regime, period, and cost slice is chronological.

module_audit.finding: The first audit sorted final trade outcomes but did not time partial exits.

Both now consume and describe the corrected chronological artifacts.

module_audit.finding: Forward metrics sorted completed trades by signal time.
